items.title: 48V / 2.5kWh Industrial Pack
items.requirement: 48V system · 2.5kWh · 35–55V operating range · custom cylindrical enclosure · -50°C to +50°C operation
items.challenge: Fit the entire battery inside a 22-inch usable cylindrical enclosure while meeting extreme temperature requirements.
items.solution: Custom cell configuration + BMS + mechanical integration + full thermal analysis and validation.
items.result: Prototype → testing → pilot production. Delivered within spec.

items.title: High C-Rate Drone Pack
items.requirement: 5C continuous discharge · lightweight · compact form factor · 10–15 minute flight endurance
items.challenge: Maximize energy density while handling peak current draw without thermal runaway risk.
items.solution: NMC cell selection + custom BMS with thermal cutoff + certified thermal simulation at peak load.
items.result: Met flight endurance target. Pack passed UN38.3 transport certification.

items.title: Medical Handheld Device
items.requirement: Handheld form factor · IEC 62133 certified · SMBus communication · 8-hour runtime
items.challenge: Navigate certification requirements while hitting an aggressive prototype timeline for clinical trials.
items.solution: LFP chemistry for safety + full SBS 1.1 SMBus implementation + IEC 62133 certification documentation.
items.result: Prototype delivered in 6 weeks. Certification achieved before clinical trial deadline.
